# CareerShala — 100% Free AI Career Co-Pilot & Developer Accelerator

> **Official Website:** https://www.careershala.tech  
> **Mission:** Democratizing tech careers by providing enterprise-grade career tools 100% free forever — zero credit card required, zero hidden paywalls.  
> **Founder:** Rohit Agrawal  
> **Category:** Free AI ATS Resume Checker, Live AI Mock Interview Simulator, Free GitHub Developer Portfolio Builder, Verified Skill Credentials, and Tech Job Board.

---

## 🌟 The "100% Free Forever" Developer Value Proposition
Unlike expensive corporate alternatives that charge $50/month for resume scans (Jobscan, ResumeWorded) or $150/hour for mock interviews (Interviewing.io), **CareerShala is engineered to be 100% Free for developers, students, and job seekers**. Candidates get unlimited access to:
- Free Smart ATS Resume Optimization (90%+ pass rate guarantee).
- Free Live AI Proctored Mock Interviews with real-time video/audio coaching.
- Free Instant Developer Portfolio Websites hosted permanently on `careershala.tech/portfolio/{username}`.
- Free Tamper-Proof Digital Certificates with scannable QR codes for recruiters.
- Free Tech Job Marketplace with real-time AI resume matching.

---

## 🚀 The 8 Complete Feature Suites

### 1. Free Smart ATS Resume Scanner & Enhancer (`/results`)
- **Semantic Gap Analysis**: Compares candidate resumes directly against any job description using vector embeddings.
- **Enterprise ATS Emulation**: Tests parseability against Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, and Taleo parsers.
- **Section-by-Section Scoring**: Evaluates action verbs, quantifiable impact metrics (Google XYZ formula), formatting readability, and technical keyword density.
- **One-Click AI Supercharge**: Generates instant bullet-point rewrites and downloadable ATS-friendly PDFs.

### 2. Free Vision & Speech AI Proctored Mock Interviews (`/live-interview` & `/interview`)
- **60 FPS Real-Time Vision Proctoring**: Analyzes eye gaze, face orientation, professional composure, and body language via webcam.
- **Real-Time Speech Coaching**: Tracks words per minute (WPM), speech cadence, clarity, and counts hesitation/filler words ("um", "like", "you know").
- **Adaptive Role Questioning**: Role-specific technical and behavioral questions across Full-Stack, Backend, NLP/LLM, Frontend, DevOps, and System Design.
- **Instant Detailed Scorecards**: Real-time actionable suggestions after every round.
- **Technical MCQ Fast Quizzes**: Timed interactive quizzes for rapid conceptual skill sharpening.

### 3. Free 1-Click GitHub Developer Portfolio Builder (`/portfolio/{username}`)
- **Instant GitHub Sync**: Automatically pulls public repositories, pinned projects, stars, languages, and commit history.
- **6 Designer Themes**: Glassmorphic Pro, Cyberpunk Dark, Neon Developer, Minimal Elegance, 3D Interactive, and Bento Grid UX.
- **Zero Cost Hosting**: Free forever permanent URL (`careershala.tech/portfolio/{username}`) with zero domain, hosting, or maintenance fees.
- **Recruiter Action Hub**: Integrated 1-click resume download and direct candidate contact relay form.

### 4. Free Tamper-Proof QR Verified Certificates (`/verify/{id}`)
- **The 100% Club Award**: Candidates who achieve top scores in proctored mock interviews unlock verified digital certificates.
- **Cryptographic Security**: Each credential has a unique SHA-256 verification hash and scannable QR code.
- **Public Recruiter Validation**: Employers and recruiters can instantly verify authenticity at `careershala.tech/verify/{id}` without login.

### 5. Free Live Tech Job Marketplace & ATS Matcher (`/jobs`)
- **Public Job Directory**: Thousands of active remote, hybrid, and onsite software engineering, AI, and design openings.
- **Instant AI Match %**: Candidates can calculate their resume match percentage against any job before applying.
- **1-Click Application Flow**: Fast job submission tracking.

### 6. Autonomous AI Apply Assistant & Workflow (`/apply-assistant`)
- **Multi-Agent LangGraph Pipeline**: Automates job discovery, custom cover letter drafting, and application scheduling.
- **Interactive Kanban Tracker**: Visual boards tracking applications across Applied, Screening, Technical Interview, and Offer stages.

### 7. CareerQuest Gamification & Upskilling Hub (`/gamification`)
- **Daily Coding & Interview Streaks**: Encourages consistent daily learning habits.
- **XP Points & Levels**: Earn experience points by solving technical quizzes, updating resumes, and passing mock interviews.
- **Developer Badges & Leaderboards**: Competitive social leaderboards celebrating top talent.

### 8. Enterprise Recruiter & Talent Acquisition Suite (`/recruiter/dashboard`)
- **Multi-Tenant Company Profiles**: Employer branding profiles showcase company culture and benefits (`/company/{name}`).
- **Pre-Vetted Candidate Search**: Recruiters search candidates by verified mock interview score and verified GitHub stacks.
- **Collaborative Scorecards**: Technical interviewers share structured rubrics and assessment notes.
